You can also enter the console's address instead.

data.value: First, on the console: Settings > System > Remote Play, and turn on Enable Remote Play. To wake it from rest mode as well, turn on Stay Connected to the Internet and Enable Turning On PS5 from Network, under Settings > System > Power Saving > Features Available in Rest Mode.
